title: GraveGain1DA
description: A one-dimensional GraveGain RPG: walk the ley-line east, turn-based or real-time, 5 sectors, bosses, and endless Echo Drift. BIG upgrade: emoji-parallax art + emergent wanderers with quests and events.

maker.name: 4weird Games
maker.bio: One dimension is all a courier needs: walk east, hold the line, deliver the charge.

keyboard.Right Arrow / D: Step east (turn-based: 1 tick; real-time: move intent)

touch.scheme: One-thumb crypt line + ritual tap bar
touch.crypt line: Tap LEFT half = STEP east, tap RIGHT half = ATTACK. Hold LEFT = auto-march, hold RIGHT = charge ritual (ABILITY) then steady strikes
touch.ritual tap bar: Big STEP / ATK / RITUAL buttons (STEP+ATK hold-to-repeat) plus POT / WAIT
touch.layout: Vertical portrait stack: HUD / stage / crypt line / ritual bar, safe-area padded, 64px+ targets

instructions: Pick turn-based or real-time, pick a class, and walk east along the ley-line toward Hades' spire. Clear 5 sectors and their bosses, then push into endless Echo Drift. You can never move left and never jump — the line only goes right.
